name: color-space
description: Every color in your file on one plane, in OKLCH, HCT, CAM16, Display P3 or any of 168 color spaces: CSS, Swift, Flutter, Compose, Unity, Godot, Unreal, design tokens, themes and palettes, written back in their own notation.

enumDescriptions: Display P3: the wide gamut of current Apple and many other displays
colorSpace.gamut.markdownDescription: The gamut the picker writes in, for notations that can name wider colors (`oklch()`, `lab()`, `color(display-p3 …)`…). `#hex`, `rgb()`, `hsl()` and `hwb()` are always written inside sRGB.

enumDescriptions: Shader vectors aren't read as colors
vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.0) and its kin are gamma-encoded sRGB
vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.0) and its kin are linear-light sRGB
colorSpace.shaders.markdownDescription: Whether 0–1 vectors in shaders (`vec3`/`vec4` in GLSL, `vec3f` in WGSL, `float3` in HLSL and Metal) are colors, and how to read them. Off by default: a vector is as often a position.
